verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general Python/TypeScript SDKs, an MCP server, and a Claude Code plugin, plus a generic claim that Honcho can be queried 'from any model or framework.' None of it documents a first-party integration with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK. The generic SDKs and MCP server are building blocks or adjacent integrations, not the named framework integrations the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the memory layer into agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK via documented first-party integrations
